 "description": "Explores the science of sustainable food production around the world and examines the issues related to nutrition and hunger, food safety, and food production. Also discusses issues such as soil health, genetically modified (and engineered) foods, water use, governmental food guidelines, and human health. Pulls focus on the thematic topics from scientific literature but also includes additional sources of information, such as gray literature, media coverage, documentaries, and popular nonfiction.
